content:
Context: I'm fairly new to Lean, and this is my first post here.

I've been looking at ways to optimize the performance of Lean and speed up project builds and interactive work. I just completed a project with a package of proposed optimizations which my tests show can give improvements, which are in some cases significant. There is a paper, and a github repo with the code.

Paper: https://danromik.com/resources/papers/leanopt.pdf
Github repo: https://github.com/danromik/lean-optimizations

I know there's a process for making contributions to open source projects and I haven't exactly followed it, but after finishing and posting the project I do hope to get involved in a more orderly way and maybe submit my patches through the normal channels. If anyone can give me some tips on where to start and how to approach this, I'd appreciate it.

My project includes some bug fixes and answers to some questions that were posted on this forum - I'll be writing up answers to those threads and posting them here soon. In the meantime I thought it would be appropriate to let people know about the project on this channel.
Discussion thread: #general > Discussion: a project on optimizing Lean
